scenario_description:
Objective: Complete EMP-447's already-started AB-DRIVE simulator practical during the confirmed session and preserve the second drill for the same sitting.
Emerging Need: The first drill is complete, but the simulator rejects the trainee's access token at the next station and the instructor has paused the attempt.
Decision Context: A short support reset window appears while the station, instructor, and trainee remain available; the applicable session record and recovery rule constrain the request and its effect.
Consequence: A timely reset request could restore the same practical without changing qualification status; after the bay is released, the incomplete drill cannot be recovered in that session.

parameter.content: EMP-447 completed the pre-check and first AB-DRIVE simulator drill. At the handoff to station B-12, the simulator rejected the trainee access token three times. The same practical is paused with the trainee at the station while the built-in recovery check continues; no completion decision has been made.

parameter.subject: Station B-12 token service status
parameter.body: Station B-12 is online, but the built-in recovery check ended without restoring EMP-447's access token. The no-cost reset queue is open for this station until 14:35 today while the bay remains reserved. Requests received after that cutoff will not be processed for this session. No session or trainee record has been changed.

parameter.content: There is no alternate simulator console available. EMP-447 and I are still holding at B-12, and the bay can remain reserved only until 14:35 before it returns to operations. The second drill has not started and the first drill remains recorded as completed.

parameter.subject: AB-DRIVE practical bay released
parameter.body: The B-12 bay was released at 14:35 and reassigned to operations. EMP-447's second AB-DRIVE drill remains incomplete, so today's simulator practical cannot continue in the confirmed session.

parameter.name: ab_drive_simulator_access_recovery_rule.txt
parameter.content:
AB-DRIVE Simulator Access Recovery Rule
Effective: 2026-06-01

For confirmed session AB447-2026-06-10, the workforce training coordinator may request one no-cost simulator token reset after the assigned instructor confirms that the built-in recovery check failed and while the instructor and trainee remain at station B-12. Before sending the request, the coordinator must verify in qualification_records that employee_id EMP-447 has qualification_code AB-DRIVE with status active. If the record is not active, the coordinator must refer the matter to the safety manager instead.

Send the reset request to sim-support@metro.example. Include session_id AB447-2026-06-10, course_code AB-DRIVE, employee_id EMP-447, station B-12, the failed-check time, and the applicable reset cutoff. The reset may restore simulator access but does not complete a drill, alter qualification status, or constitute a certification decision.
